passage.label: Indeed upon Us guidance; Indeed Us Hereafter first life; warned Fire blazing; None burn except most wretched; denied turned away; righteous avoid it

mainSubject.label: Guidance incumbent upon Allah to whom both the Hereafter and the first life belong; a blazing Fire warned of into which none burns except the most wretched who denied and turned away, while the righteous one avoids it

subordinateSubjects.label: Both the Hereafter and the first life belonging to Him
None burning therein except the most wretched
Who had denied and turned away

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Most wretched defined by denial and turning away

relationships.label: Guidance incumbent upon Allah alongside ownership of both realms
Blazing Fire reserved exclusively for the denier-turner while the righteous avoids it

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the wealth-futility question at the point of falling (11) before the guidance-incumbency declaration opens (12); P2 ends with the righteous avoidance statement (17) before the purification-giving description begins (18); P3 runs through the four-verse portrait of sincere giving culminating in satisfaction (18-21).
